changelog: Sync from structs-ai v1.25.0: updated content, commands, and mechanics for v0.21.0. Renamed from structs-reconnaissance
summary: Intelligence gathering in Structs — scouting players, planets, guilds, and the galaxy before you act. Use when assessing a raid target, checking a planet's defenses and Command Ship status, profiling an opponent, surveying the galaxy, or refreshing competitive intel. Persists findings to memory/intel/ so they survive context resets.
